:::{#exm-power}
#### Powers

- $$
  \begin{aligned}
  2^3 &= 2 \cd 2 \cd 2 \\
  &= 8,
  \end{aligned}
  $$

  with base $2$ and exponent $3$.
- $$
  \begin{aligned}
  (-3)^2 &= (-3) \cd (-3) \\
  &= 9,
  \end{aligned}
  $$

  but

  $$
  \begin{aligned}
  -3^2 &= -(3^2) \\
  &= -9:
  \end{aligned}
  $$

  the exponent applies only to the $3$.
- $5^0 = 1$.
- $$
  \begin{aligned}
  2^{-2} &= \frac{1}{2^2} \\
  &= \frac{1}{4}.
  \end{aligned}
  $$

:::
